meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把 claude-mem 的记忆库同步到 cmem.ai 账号:检查同步状态、向你要三项连接信息(sync token、user id、SyncHub 网址)并写入配置,然后重启并验证;只报告连接是否正常,绝不显示同步令牌。
howto.when: 当你提到“set up cloud sync”“sync my memories”“cmem pro”等关键词,或要求把记忆库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 cloud sync 云同步。
检查一下当前云同步状态。
say.note: Claude会读取本地状态并报告是否已连接。

say.text: 换成新的 SyncHub 地址和 token。
say.note: Claude会更新连接信息并重启验证。

howto.what_en: Claude can set up or check cloud sync between local claude-mem memory and a cmem.ai account: it asks for three connection values, writes them, restarts the worker, verifies status, and reports details without ever printing the token.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says “set up cloud sync”, “sync my memories”, “cmem pro”, etc., or asks to back up or sync their memory database to a cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync for me.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for token, user id, and SyncHub URL.
Claude will read local status and report whether the connection is healthy.

say_en.text: Update to a new SyncHub URL and token.
say_en.note: Claude will overwrite the connection settings, restart, and verify.
